Dear Marina Capelli,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding the shipment of Hot Rolled Coils.

We are pleased to provide you with the following freight quote based on the details provided:

Route:
Origin: Karasu, Turkey
Destination: Puerto Limon, Costa Rica

Vessel Details:
Vessel Name: MV PETRA (Handysize Bulk Carrier)
Built: 2007
DWT: 14,200 MT
DWCC: 13,850 MT
Cranes: 3 x 25T deck cranes

Cargo Details:
Commodity: Hot Rolled Coils (HRC)
Weight: 10,400 Metric Tons (MT)
Description: Breakbulk cargo, with individual coil weight not exceeding 20 MT.
Laycan: June 2026
Vessel Open: Karasu, Turkey around June 8, 2026

Commercial Terms:
Freight Rate: 23.50 USD per Metric Ton
Discharge Terms: Liner Out (LO)
Loading Terms: To be advised

Validity:
This quote is valid for 7 calendar days from the date of this email.

To finalize this offer and proceed with a firm booking, please confirm the following outstanding details:
1.  Exact loading dates required within June 2026.
2.  Specific loading terms (e.g., Free In, Liner In).
3.  Applicable Incoterms.

We look forward to your prompt response.

Best regards,

Quantika

عزيزي أحمد الرشيدي،

يسعدنا أن نقدم لكم عرض سعر شحن بخصوص استفساركم لشحنة الحبوب.

تفاصيل المسار والشحنة:
السلعة: قمح سائب
الكمية: 8,500 طن متري (الحد الأدنى 8,000 طن متري، الحد الأقصى 9,000 طن متري)
شروط الإنكوترمز: CIF
ميناء التحميل: الإسكندرية، مصر
ميناء التفريغ: جدة، المملكة العربية السعودية
فترة التحميل/الإلغاء (Laycan): 15 - 25 يونيو 2026
معدل التحميل: 3,000 طن متري يومياً
معدل التفريغ: 2,000 طن متري يومياً
متطلبات خاصة: شهادة صحة نباتية مطلوبة؛ دليل تحميل الحبوب متوفر على متن السفينة.

السفينة المقترحة:
اسم السفينة: MV AL-NOUR
النوع: سفينة بضائع سائبة من فئة Handysize
الحمولة الساكنة (DWT): 12,000 طن متري (سعة الحمولة الصافية DWCC: 11,700 طن متري)
العلم: البحرين
سنة الصنع: 2004
جمعية التصنيف: LR
نادي الحماية والتعويض (P&I): UK P&I
سعة الحبوب: 15,200 متر مكعب
الرافعات: مزودة (2 × رافعة بقدرة 30 طن)
الموقع المتاح: الإسكندرية، تاريخ الوصول المتوقع: 13 يونيو 2026
آخر الشحنات: حبوب، أسمدة.

سعر الشحن:
[RATE TO BE CONFIRMED]
سعر الشحن التجاري: 18 دولار أمريكي للطن المتري

العمولة:
2.5% ATDN SHINC (في جميع الأوقات ليلاً ونهاراً بما في ذلك أيام الآحاد والعطلات الرسمية) لكلا الطرفين.

الشروط والأحكام:
صلاحية العرض: هذا العرض صالح لمدة 7 أيام من تاريخه.

يرجى عدم التردد في الاتصال بنا في حال وجود أي استفسارات أو لطلب مزيد من التوضيحات. نتطلع إلى تأكيدكم.

مع خالص التقدير،
كوانتيكا

Dear Serkan Varan,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding the shipment of your project cargo.

We are pleased to provide the following preliminary freight quotation for the carriage of your storage tanks from Marmara, Turkey to Vera Cruz, Mexico.

Route:
Origin: Marmara, Turkey
Destination: Vera Cruz, Mexico

Cargo Details:
Commodity: 14 pieces of Storage Tanks (10 x 160m3 VT Storage Tanks, 4 x 80m3 GMMOS Tanks)
Total Weight: 186 Metric Tons
Total Volume: 2120 Cubic Meters
Dimensions:
  - 10 units: 4.3m (L) x 15.7m (H) x 4.3m (W) each
  - 4 units: 12.1m (L) x 3.2m (H) x 3.2m (W) each
Loading Window (Laycan): 15-20 June 2026
Special Note: On-deck stowage is acceptable.

Proposed Vessel:
MV HELIOS
Type: General Cargo, Open Hatch
Cranes: 1 x 40T deck crane
Open Position: Marmara, as of 12 June 2026
The MV HELIOS is well-suited for project cargo and heavy lifts.

Freight Rate:
[RATE TO BE CONFIRMED]

Commercial Terms:
Basis: GENCON Charter Party terms.
Commission: 3.75% Total Commission (TTL), payable as per GENCON CP.
Bill of Lading: On-deck B/L to be signed.

To finalize this quotation and ensure accurate planning, please confirm the following:
1.  Whether shore or vessel crane/gear is specifically required for handling the oversized tanks during loading and discharge operations.
2.  The exact port rotation and number of discharge ports, if different from a single discharge at Vera Cruz.

Validity:
This quotation is valid for seven (7) calendar days from the date of this email.

We look forward to your confirmation of the pending details and are available to discuss this further at your convenience.

Best regards,

Quantika

Subject: Freight Quote Inquiry - Novorossiysk to Istanbul - Steam Coal - MV BLACK SEA STAR

Dear Dmitri Volkov,

Thank you for your freight inquiry. We are pleased to offer a quote for the carriage of your cargo.

Based on the details provided, we propose the following:

Route: Novorossiysk, Russia to Istanbul, Turkey
Cargo: Steam coal in bulk, Russian origin
Quantity: 25,000 metric tons (24,000-26,000 MT)
Stowage Factor: 1.20 m3/MT
Loading Port: Novorossiysk
Discharge Port: Istanbul
Laycan: 01-15 July 2026
Incoterms: FOB

Vessel: MV BLACK SEA STAR
Type: Supramax Bulk Carrier
DWT: 56,000 MT (DWCC 54,800 MT)
Flag: Marshall Islands
Built: 2010
P&I: Gard (IG Group Club)
Open Position: Novorossiysk, eta 28 June 2026

Loading Rate: 5,000 MTPD SHINC
Discharge Rate: 4,000 MTPD SHINC

Freight Rate: [RATE TO BE CONFIRMED]
Commission: 3.75% TTL ATDN

Special Requirements:
- Coal Certificate required
- Vessel to be P&I insured with IG Club (fulfilled by Gard)

Additional Clauses:
- War Risk Premium: 0.25% of declared cargo value (Black Sea trading area)
- Sanctions Exclusions Clause: Russian-origin coal only, BIMCO Sanctions Clause 2022 to apply
- Additional insurance rider required for Black Sea routing

This quote is valid for 7 calendar days from the date of this email. We await your confirmation to proceed.

Please let us know if you require any further clarification or assistance.

Best regards,

Quantika

Subject: Freight Quote for China Clay - Teignmouth to Alexandria

Dear Elif Kisabacak,

Thank you for your freight inquiry.

We are pleased to offer the following quote for the shipment of China Clay:

Route: Teignmouth, United Kingdom to Alexandria, Egypt
Cargo: China Clay in bulk (STW/DWT)
Quantity: 3,000 MT
Cargo Type: BULK
Laycan: 25–28 July 2026

Vessel Recommendation:
We recommend the MV STAD, a Vanuatu-flagged GENERAL CARGO vessel, built 1989.
Key specifications: DWT Summer 3,222 MT, DWCC 3,050 MT, 1 Hold / 1 Hatch, Gearless (shore cranes by charterers).
The MV STAD is expected to be open and available in Teignmouth, UK on 25 July 2026, aligning with your preferred loading dates.

Rate: [RATE TO BE CONFIRMED]

Terms & Conditions:
Loading Rate: Please advise loading rate at Teignmouth.
Discharge Rate: Shore cranes to be supplied by charterers.
Commission: 3.75% TTL GENCON 76.
Special Requirements: Grab loading/discharge, holds clean and dry prior loading, China Clay Association B/L form.
Demurrage: EUR 1,500 PDPR FD.
Charter Party: GENCON 76.
Arbitration: London, English law.
Incoterms: Please specify your preferred Incoterms for this shipment.

This quote is valid for 7 days from the date of this email, subject to vessel availability and re-confirmation.

Please do not hesitate to contact us should you require any further information or clarification.

Best regards,

Quantika
